system.name: AudioLDM
system.one_liner: Text-to-audio generation with latent diffusion in a VAE latent space conditioned on contrastive audio-text embeddings, also giving zero-shot audio inpainting and style transfer.

content.variant_note: one main diagram with training (solid) and sampling (dashed) paths, plus two smaller task diagrams (inpainting, style transfer) that reuse the same coloured blocks
content.argues: One latent diffusion model, trained with audio embeddings and sampled with text embeddings, generates audio from text and, without retraining, also inpaints and restyles audio.
content.subject: AudioLDM's training and sampling paths through encoders, VAE, latent diffusion and vocoder, and its inpainting and style-transfer uses.

encoding.line_style_means: Solid = training, dashed = sampling (key in (a)); dotted = the zero-shot paths in (b) and (c), not in the key; grey dash-dotted = contrastive link between the encoders.
encoding.shape_means: Rounded boxes = networks; small 3D cuboids = latent tensors; strips of small cells = embedding vectors; white rounded box = signal processing; noise-textured grey box = noising step; funnel glyph = compression or expansion.
encoding.marker_means: Formulas under or beside each tensor give its symbol and size (E in R^L, X in R^{T×F}, z in R^{C×T/r×F/r}); letters (a)-(c) name the panels.
encoding.emphasis: Latent Diffusion is the only green block and sits in the centre of every panel; (b) and (c) reuse the colours of (a) so they read as variations of one system.

summary: AudioLDM generates audio from text with a latent diffusion model (LDM) in a VAE latent space, trained on audio embeddings and sampled with text embeddings, and also edits audio zero-shot. Figure 1 has three lettered panels drawn in the same flat, colour-per-module style. Panel (a) shows the whole system: waveform, STFT+MelFB, audio and text encoders tied by a contrastive objective, VAE encoder and decoder around the green Latent Diffusion block, vocoder and generated audio; solid arrows are training, dashed arrows sampling. Panels (b) and (c) redraw the same blocks for audio inpainting (a half-masked spectrogram is completed) and style transfer (a source latent is noised by Forward Diffusion and restyled under a text prompt).
summary_zh: AudioLDM 在 VAE 潜空间里做文本到音频的潜扩散生成。图 1 分 (a)(b)(c) 三个面板：(a) 画出编码器、VAE、潜扩散和声码器，实线表示训练、虚线表示采样；(b)(c) 复用同样的彩色模块，演示音频补全和风格迁移。
notes: The pre-screen listed model-anatomy and stage-pipeline with three panels; kept. The roles of the audio and text encoders as CLAP encoders come from the paper text, the figure only says Audio Encoder, Text Encoder and Contrastive objective. Dotted arrows in (b) and (c) are not explained in the figure. In (c) the link from z_{n0} to Latent Diffusion is recorded as adjacency because no arrow is clearly visible. The relations for (b) and (c) are given as one chain each.
